name: Midjourney
summary: AI image and video generation service: text prompts become images on the web app or Discord, sold as subscription plans.
description: An AI research lab's generation service: write a prompt on the Create page of midjourney.com or through the Discord bot, get four image options, then upscale, vary, personalize or turn images into videos. Four subscription tiers (Basic, Standard, Pro, Mega) gate Fast hours, unlimited Relax mode and Stealth mode; official docs cover prompting, settings and billing.
contains: four subscription tiers: Basic, Standard, Pro and Mega
unlimited Relax mode image generations on Standard and up, video on Pro and up
Stealth mode (private generations) only on Pro and Mega plans
images generate as four options per prompt
image-to-video animation of Midjourney creations and uploaded images
official help center for prompting, settings and billing
